description: Central de Triagem de Resíduos Sólidos (cooperativas e associações) is a dataset listed in City of São Paulo open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by AMLURB - Autoridade Municipal de Limpeza Urbana (INATIVO). Das 22 organizações que mantêm uma relação formal com a Prefeitura de São Paulo, 21 cooperativas ou associações desenvolvem atividades de coleta seletiva, triagem e processamento de RSD Secos, e uma desenvolve atividades de recuperação de resíduos eletroeletrônicos (REE). Coverage: São Paulo. The portal files it under the publisher AMLURB - Autoridade Municipal de Limpeza Urbana (INATIVO). Its tags are Cooperativas, Desenvolvimento Urbano, Meio-Ambiente, Resíduos Sólidos, triagem. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, SHP, XLS. The portal shows 2020-01-29 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-spcity-portal.
